tests.execution_detail: Initial 135 tests passed. Added one engine atomic-rejection test, then all five focused tests passed: 136 distinct tested cases, 140 executions. No production changes between runs.
tests.expected: Count equals rendered quads across empty/full/neighbor/material/water/model/fractional fixtures; counting preserves render bytes; same aggregate mesh-budget error; engine rejects before publication and clears busy; interruption cancels both modes.
tests.observed: All assertions passed. Thirteen isolated checkerboard cells emit 159744 quads and pass; fourteen reject the vertex budget in both modes. Engine rejection leaves commits at zero, model count/revision unchanged and busy false.

probe.method: Three warmups and 20 measured runs per fixture. Parent first, separate JVMs, no concurrent Maven or native playtest. Build fixtures and hash complete render arrays outside timing. Count invokes through reflection, included in time/allocation. All three parent/current render hashes and quad counts match.
probe.limitations: CPU component only; current-thread allocation is not peak process memory. Small full-cell median/worst increased. Fixed thread-local scratch and fractional masks remain. No placement, city/maximum, GPU, frame/tick or network qualification.

Changed fixture construction to fill, which accepts world material values; then both complete runs exited 0. Failed partial output was replaced, not used.
